steps.title: Freaky Friday
steps.text: Go to the Basement of Doom, located under a house west of Edgeville bank.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: I was looking for a quest.

steps.title: Chores of doom
steps.text: Search the wardrobe for a broom and bed bug cleaner.
Search the shelf for a bar of soap.
Wash the dishes in the sink.
Take the knife on the sink.
Search the bookcase by the stairs.

actions.text: No, I need to find the spellbook.

steps.text: Search behind the boiler in the southeast corner.
Search the drapes by the bed.

Investigate Dave's spellbook.
  • If you interact with Dave's spellbook again and get the message 'I don't need to use the spellbook right now', interact with the drapes once more and the option to teleport to Makeover Mage will appear.
Withdraw the law rune, stew, and old rug from Dave's bank
Refill the flask from any of the water fountains.
Talk to the shopkeeper at the general store to the north.

steps.title: Sneaking in
steps.text: Pickup the hand-written note in front of you.
Search the suit of armour to the west for a knight's helmet.
Search the crates in the west for some gunpowder.
Use the gunpowder on the helmet.
Use the hand-written note on the helmet.
Use the helmet with fuse on the torch on the wall.

actions.displayName: Knight's helmet filled with gunpowder and a fuse

steps.text: Get close to the guard and throw the lit decoy bomb.
Follow the path and open the door.
Talk to Sir Amik to determine you need to give him more to drink.

Follow these steps quickly:
  • Click the keg and wait for the drink callout.
  • Click the correct option.
  • Immediately click Sir Amik Varze.

steps.title: Recruitment
steps.text:
Talk to Felicity or Margaret the hell-rats.
  • If they appear as normal hell-rats: go up the stairs for a dialogue and go back down.
Recruit any 3 of the other hell-rats.
Climb up the stairs to get to Shantay Pass.
Click the empty shell to add a hell-rat to it.
Climb up the rope on the northeastern wall.
Try to open the Jail door.
Talk to the shady man to receive a jewel.
Search the barrel inside of the jail cell to take one.
Talk to the border guards to exchange the jewel for a rope.
Use the rope on the coconut tree.
Click the barrel in your inventory to load the last hell-rat into it.
Use the old rug (you got from the bank earlier) on the barrel.
Roll the barrel past the Shantay pass.

steps.title: SECRET TUNNEL
steps.text: Search the hole that has a slight twinkle to it.

Enter the sparkling holes 4 times.
  • You can also hover your mouse over the holes until you spot the hole with a little rat icon next to it.
Attempt to enter the mysterious entrance as a hell-rat.
Grab Dave from the empty cooking range south-east.

Gather 5 hell-rats.
  • If cutscene does not begin, gather the sixth hell-rat.
